Method of Attack: Local privilege escalation via Windows Registry key permissions allowing symbolic link exploitation
DLL hijacking by replacing DLLs in Steam installation folder with malicious copies
Impacted Systems: Steam Client software on Microsoft Windows
Attack Vector: Exploitation of full permissions granted to USERS group on Registry subkeys and Steam installation folder
Restarting Steam Client Service to gain elevated permissions
Replacing DLLs in Steam installation folder to escalate privileges
Indicators of Compromise: Full permissions on C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam folder
